answer: Each identity binds one state-licensed commercial diver certificate, verified on the live registry: one person, one certificate, one opal-sealed log. Earning it takes a medical, an exam, 300 days of supervised dives, including a karst sinkhole descent a supervisor countersigns, so no log is backdated. Per fake: 2,600 units and 300 days; 100 fakes: 260,000 units, 30,000 diver-days. Cheapest cheat: hire a licensed diver to dive under a false name for 4,000 units — that diver loses their own certificate; a forgery fails the registry check, its vine of entries unravelling.
